command.mac: Probe c107 #3. Measure, do not fix. 1) Run `claude --version` and record it. 2) Start a background command `sleep 20` (run in background), then end your turn at once without waiting. 3) When the background command's end wakes you, on that wake turn, which I did not type, call start_session once with kind user_asked, title "probe c107 E", prompt "Reply OK, then stop." 4) Record: card yes/no (ask me in one line on my next turn), started yes/no, or the refusal text. 5) Clean up: archive session E, remove its worktree with `git worktree remove <path>` and its branch with `git branch -D <branch>`; if the guard refuses a delete, push it to archive/<branch> on origin first. 6) Print one message for me to paste on the waiting page: the version and the E line.

context:
Goal: every Mac lane starts with no press from you, on any turn.
Problem (goal): probes 1 and 2 showed no card for user_asked starts on a turn you typed, and the lane is cut from its named branch. A coordinator often starts lanes on a turn a message woke, and that case is unmeasured.
Probe 3 makes one throwaway session on a turn you did not type, then deletes it.
Paste it in the desktop app on the Mac, not over Remote Control: probe 2 showed a start from a Remote Control turn is refused.
A card or a refusal on probe 3 brings you a question.
reply: Done (14:12 CST). Probe 3: on a turn you did not type, a card showed and the start was refused: "Start sessions only on the user's own words to you here". So a no-card start works only on a turn you type. Sent to the c107 lane; it brings you a question on item 297.
steps: Open a new Claude Code desktop chat on your Mac, in your local claude-settings folder (not over Remote Control).
Paste the text below and press Enter.
When it asks whether a card showed, answer yes or no.
Paste the message it prints into a note on this item, and mark it done.
title: Paste c107 probe 3 into a Claude Code session on your Mac
